raw_response:
I have farmed these 3.5 mu in Quzhou County for 25 years. I finished primary school — that is all — but I know this land by working it. My household has six people, and some of us work off-farm, so we do not have time for a double crop. I grow spring maize, one crop a year on these 3.5 mu.

This year I will plant Zhengdan 958, hybrid seed. That is what my neighbors plant, and the seed dealer in town always recommends it. I need about 2.5 kg of seed per mu, so I bought 9 kg for the whole plot. Last year I used the same variety and it did fine.

For fertilizer, I will do what I did last year. At sowing, I spread about 30 kg per mu of compound fertilizer — the 15-15-15 kind in the green bags. That is a bit more than half of a 50 kg bag for each mu. Then when the corn reaches the big trumpet stage — knee to waist high — I top-dress with about 18 kg per mu of urea. That is a bit more than one-third of a 50 kg bag per mu. I know that is probably more than what the book says, but I would rather waste a little fertilizer than risk a bad harvest. A bad year means my family goes short. Wasting fertilizer just means I spent a bit more money.

I irrigate three times from my well. The first time right after sowing to settle the seeds. The second time when the corn is growing fast and the leaves start curling. The third time when the tassels come out and the ears are filling. Pumping costs electricity, so I do not water for no reason, but three good soakings are enough if the rain is normal.

For chemicals, I spray herbicide once after sowing — the same brand I bought last year from the dealer. Then I keep an eye out for armyworms and aphids. If I see damage, I spray insecticide. I usually end up spraying twice in total. I do not spray for fun — every spray costs money — but I cannot let the insects eat my crop.

I till the land with a rotary tiller before sowing. I do not plow deep. Rotary tillage is faster, and my neighbor's tractor does it for me.

I expect about 550 kg per mu this year, maybe 600 if the summer rains come at the right time. Last year I got about 550 kg per mu. I do not expect miracles. I just want a steady harvest to feed the family and sell a bit.
